items.headline: Brazil Advances to Round of 16
items.body: Brazil successfully navigated Group C, securing their spot in the knockout stages. They then defeated Japan in a thrilling Round of 32 encounter, setting up a clash with Norway.

items.headline: Round of 32 Victory over Japan
items.body: Brazil secured a dramatic 2-1 victory against Japan in the Round of 32 on June 29, with Gabriel Martinelli scoring a 95th-minute winner. The match was played at Houston Stadium.

items.headline: Strong Group Stage Performance
items.body: Brazil finished their Group C campaign with a draw against Morocco (1-1) and dominant wins over Haiti (3-0) and Scotland (3-0). This strong showing ensured their progression to the knockout rounds.

items.headline: Ancelotti's Tactical Approach
items.body: Coach Carlo Ancelotti has favored a 4-2-4 formation, aiming for an attacking style of play despite some pre-tournament injury setbacks. Key players like Vinicius Jr. and Gabriel Martinelli have been crucial in attack.

items.headline: Paquetá Out with Hamstring Injury
items.body: Midfielder Lucas Paquetá sustained a hamstring injury during the Round of 32 match against Japan and is expected to be sidelined for three weeks. This injury likely rules him out for the remainder of the tournament.

items.headline: Raphinha Nearing Return
items.body: Winger Raphinha, who suffered a hamstring injury during the group stage, has reportedly returned to individual training. His availability for upcoming matches remains questionable but is trending positively.

items.headline: Neymar's Calf Injury Managed
items.body: Neymar has been managing a calf injury, which saw him miss Brazil's opening group stage match. He has since returned to full tactical training and has featured in subsequent games.

items.headline: Round of 16 vs. Norway
items.body: Brazil will face Norway in the Round of 16 on July 5, 2026, at the New York/New Jersey Stadium. This will be a crucial test for the Seleção as they aim to progress further in the tournament.

metadata.venue: New York/New Jersey Stadium, East Rutherford, New Jersey

items.headline: Tactical Adjustments Expected
items.body: With Lucas Paquetá's absence, Carlo Ancelotti will need to adjust his midfield setup. The team will likely rely on its strong attacking depth and defensive solidity to counter Norway's threats, including Erling Haaland.
